errors.evidence: The description completely fails to mention that the chart is a grouped bar chart, which compares two different time periods (Q1 2020 and Q2 2020) for each economy. It does not describe the legend or the visual distinction between the two series (hatched vs. solid bars).

This statement is incorrect. The chart is a grouped bar chart where each group of bars represents one economy, and each individual bar within that group represents a specific time period (Q1 or Q2 2020).
The list of economies on the horizontal axis is incomplete; it omits "Еврозоната" (Eurozone).
The range of the vertical axis is from -25 to +5, not -25 to 0.

errors.text_span: Най-високата стълба представлява Русия, като има стойност около -5, а най-ниската стълба представлява Франция, с приблизителна стойност -5.
errors.evidence: This statement contains multiple errors. The highest value is for Turkey in Q1 2020 (approx. +0.5). The lowest value (most negative bar) is for Обединено кралство (United Kingdom) in Q2 2020 (approx. -21), not France. The values for France are approx. -5.5 (Q1) and -14 (Q2). Furthermore, stating that both the highest and lowest bars have the same value of -5 is contradictory and incorrect.
The chart label is "Обед. кралство", which is an abbreviation for "Обединено кралство" (United Kingdom). The description hallucinates the name "Американското кралство" (American Kingdom).
This phrasing is awkward and unnatural. A clearer way to state this would be that the bars are blue.
